## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one coherent scope and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand the complete change, including AI-assisted output, and have the right to contribute it.
- [ ] Relevant tests or checks are included, or the validation limits are explained above.
- [ ] Related documentation and localized strings are updated where needed.
- [ ] Any app runs/tests used isolated data, not an everyday Lumi profile.
- [ ] Text, screenshots and attachments contain no secrets, confidential prompts or private profile data.
